Subject: Need help with a breach of contract case

Hello, my name is Venkat Patel. I am a 47-year-old taxi driver living in Hubballi. Our company has a breach of contract claim of Rs. 14,66,00,000 against Banyan Infotech Pvt Ltd, and the claim must be filed as a commercial suit. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 79016 63203 or email venkat.patel16@example.com.
